text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Although Biwa Hayahide comes<n>away victorious
from the Satsuki Sho,<n>she can't help but feel that
something<n>about her calculations is off.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin's fierce competitive<n>spirit is a value
that her equation<n>can't account for.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And then there's Winning Ticket and<n>her undying
determination to win the<n>Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is the stage<n>where the three
rivals will meet again,<n>but can Biwa Hayahide quell
her<n>anxiety before then?
